in_marathi.name: Vishwakarma
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vishwakarma हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vishwakarma is the divine architect and creator of the universe in Hindu mythology. He is responsible for the creation of the world and all its beings.
